exactExcerpt: don't set your target above the highs of this resistance because you are expecting the price to break above that resistance
normalizedObservation: The target must not be moved beyond an opposing level merely to make risk-to-reward look acceptable. In a range this is called a very bad idea; in a trend, extending the target past a prior swing high is described as a defensible but lower-probability choice.
